name: fleet-tau-runner
description: fleet-tau's TypeScript runner, which type-checks and runs the model's programs in a session container with ts-executor, as `fleet-setup image` installs it in the session image

scripts.test: node -e "for (const path of ['lib', 'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo']) require('node:fs').rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -b && node --test "lib/**/*.test.js"
